title: Siman 421
section: Fleeing from Philosophical Inquiry and Strengthening in Faith

segments.he: עוֹמֵד בְּמַדְרֵגָה גָּבוֹהַּ, אַף-עַל-פִּי- כֵן עֲדַיִן אֲנִי רוֹצֶה יוֹתֵר, כִּי מִי יוֹדֵעַ, אוּלַי יֵשׁ עוֹד וְכוּ' וְכוּ':
segments.en: (15.) He said: "Tzaddikim — even these tzaddikim of today — are also very precious in the eyes of Hashem Yisburach. And even if there were nothing more to say of them than that they distance themselves from the ways of the frivolous ones who conduct themselves precisely in the ways of the nations — and walk in the ways of philosophical inquiry and secular wisdom — whose intention is specifically to make themselves resemble in their manner, clothing, and customs the customs of the nations — as has spread now, due to our many sins..."
